title: get_tailscale_status reports the tailnet down while it is up

problem.found: get_tailscale_status returns connected=false for the subnet router although tailscale status on the node shows it online and peers reach the LAN through it.
problem.evidence:
mcp-homelab get_tailscale_status -> {"connected": false, ...}
node: `tailscale status` -> pi-k3s online, offers 192.168.1.0/24
problem.proposed_change: Make get_tailscale_status read the connection state from the field the Tailscale API actually populates for a subnet router, and add a test with a recorded API response for an online subnet router.
problem.verify: A unit test with the recorded response asserts connected=true; the existing offline fixture still asserts connected=false.
